pandas.read_json

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Read a JSON file or stream. Set orient for the record layout and lines=True for newline-delimited records.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.read_json(…) Full signature
pd.read_json(
    path_or_buf,
    *,
    orient=None,
    typ='frame',
    dtype=None,
    convert_axes=None,
    convert_dates=…,
    keep_default_dates=…,
    precise_float=False,
    date_unit=None,
    encoding=None,
    encoding_errors='strict',
    lines=False,
    chunksize=None,
    compression='infer',
    nrows=None,
    storage_options=None,
    dtype_backend=…,
    engine='ujson',
)
